reason: My quotes are my business, and I am not wiring my price list and buyer enquiries into a system run by a tiny remote studio with one chemical client to its name. On top of that, Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month is more than the two local web guys I would get quotes from charge, and I can still type a quote on WhatsApp myself in ten minutes.
objection: Who maintains it if this small studio disappears? If they shut down or stop answering, my quote desk dies and I am locked into a monthly fee for something I cannot fix myself.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to that chemical-trading client myself and seeing their quote desk actually work, plus a written handover clause giving me the code and the price-list setup if ShapeKraft stops, and setup brought down to around Rs 30,000.
